summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Changes: new monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (stdlib only, type-hinted, Google-style docstring, helper _resolve_path_value); explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py; "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst with one autofunction entry; new tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and the four specified tests. Nothing was committed, and no tests or repository code were run, per instructions. No lines exceed 120 columns, but black and flake8 are not installed, so black-style formatting is unverified. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError; a non-string "test" entry fails the image type check; missing image/label fields are skipped rather than rejected.
